text:
jen: heads-up  Customer Z asked for a fast opt-in path into an edge routing canary for ~12 tenants. Wants: per-tenant opt-in/skiplist, A/B on prompt templates, tighter automatic rollback window. can we scope safe-minimal?

ajay: do they mean edge routing at the region-level or dedicated edge nodes? that changes routing policy.

rachel: they specifically requested region-based edge routing to avoid extra hop via regional pool. means we need a routing rule + fallback to regional pools if edge fails.

sree: main risks: cold KV cache for warmup, telemetry blind spots on new slice, token spend spike if sampling is too aggressive.

carl: ops asks: per-tenant kill-switch + global circuit breaker + quota guard on embedding calls.

jen: proposed minimal launch scope:
- per-tenant skiplist table (customer-managed opt-in list)
- variant sampling 5% to prompt-B for quality A/B
- explicit per-tenant kill-switch endpoint + reason logging
- telemetry hooks: 95p latency, tokens per request, small prompt-eval run

ajay: quick config sketch:
```
flag: edge_fast_opt_v1
rules:
  - if: tenant in ["z-100","z-101","z-102"]
    then: route=edge
  - if: tenant in skiplist
    then: route=regional
sampling: 0.05  # variant B
kill_switch: POST /api/flags/edge_fast_opt_v1/kill
approval_endpoint: POST /api/flags/edge_fast_opt_v1/approve
```

rachel: agree 5% start. propose automated ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 24h with telemetry gates at each step (95p latency, token delta, prompt-quality). manual approval option for "fast-opt" flow.

sree: telemetry gates: run a lightweight eval on first 500 responses per tenant (heuristics + NER checks). if quality regress > 3% -> auto-fallback. also add a short TTL for KV warmup and a background priming job.

carl: ops: add cost gating: if token spend > 2x baseline in first 2h -> reduce sampling to 1% or disable. also add alerting to SRE on-call.

jen: tradeoff note: customer wants immediate opt-in. proposal: allow "fast-opt" but require SRE on-call and manual approvals at each ramp step for the first hour. reduces blast radius.

ajay: manual approval flow feasible. deploy-bot will record timestamps.

deploy-bot: approval requested by jen for z-100 fast-opt. status: pending.

rachel: ops checklist for fast-opt: 1) add tenants to skiplist 2) enable sampling 5% 3) start KV warmup job 4) attach telemetry dashboard + alerts 5) SRE approve -> continue ramp.

sree: fallback hierarchy: primary -> regional model variant; secondary -> cheaper quantized variant + notify customer; final -> 503 with user-facing graceful message and incident ticket.

carl: also require per-tenant debug logging ON for first 6h and reason tags on kill-switch actions.

jen: owners + next steps: @ajay implement kill-switch + approval endpoint (ETA 3h). @rachel create dashboard + eval job (ETA 6h). @sree write auto-fallback rules & thresholds (ETA EOD). i'll coordinate customer ops and SRE.

ajay: will start now. will post PR for config and a small unit test.
rachel: will wire up dashboard panels and an alert rule for token delta.
sree: drafting auto-fallback ruleset now.

jen: plan to reconvene in #product in 6h for go/no-go. keep messages short in this thread. :thumbsup:
